CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.
   B. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.
   C. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Responsibility over Plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Responsibility over Plants has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Responsibility over Plants.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Functions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Functions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Functions of the Bible.
   C. Apply the teaching of Functions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Functions of the Bible has no place in daily life.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Accounts of Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Accounts of Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Accounts of Creation.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.
   C. Use The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Bible Translation has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.

13. Which response best shows understanding of John the Baptist to the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing John the Baptist to the Messiah.
   B. Use John the Baptist to the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say John the Baptist to the Messiah has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship over Creation.
   B. Apply the teaching of Stewardship over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Stewardship over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Stewardship over Creation has no place in daily life.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Prophecies about the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophecies about the Messiah.
   B. Say Prophecies about the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Prophecies about the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Divisions of the Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Translation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership in Israel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Prophecies about the Messiah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain John the Baptist to the Messiah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
